name: 需求分析动态表单与版本冻结
canceledInputs: all Implementation review conclusions derived from that plan

truthBoundary.SOL: PRE-04 lifecycle, business versions, effective pointer, completion, history, comparison and SCH facts
truthBoundary.PLATFORM: dynamic-form template, immutable revision, instance schema, values and controlled file composition
truthBoundary.PROJ: project template, WorkBinding, scope, participant and manager facts

workBinding.publishValidation: REVISION_BINDING_PUBLISH requires the exact enabled current PUBLISHED revision to pass SOL usage policy before the project-template revision is published
workBinding.runtimeFreeze: ProjectTask execution contract freezes the exact dynamic-form revision fact; REVISION_FROZEN_USE revalidates the immutable revision and compatibility but ignores later template disablement or pointer changes

pre04Compatibility.coreFileFieldCardinality: exactly one PmsFileArtifact field for every one of the 11 coreRichTextFields
pre04Compatibility.additionalFormCreateSurface: retained without SOL rewriting; full F-PLT-002 high-trust boundary applies

invariants: at most one DRAFT marker per tenant/project/PRE-04
at most one effective COMPLETED marker per tenant/project/PRE-04
a project may have one current draft and one current effective version concurrently
COMPLETED SOL root and its PLT instance are immutable
only completing a later draft may clear the prior effective marker

composition.cardinality: one PRE-04 sol_preparation row to exactly one PLT dynamic-form instance
composition.projectTemplateReference: sol_preparation.template_revision_id remains the frozen PROJ template revision

pre04Rules: dynamic_form_instance_id is NOT NULL for a persisted PRE-04 version
template_revision_id keeps PROJ template revision semantics
source_preparation_id links a next draft to its completed source
content_version changes only through SOL business commands and freezes on completion

rules: SOL business instances are not created through manual-instance REST
frozen revision and engine facts never change
COMPLETED owner policy denies all writes

sol_requirement_analysis_section.migrationPolicy: do not edit executed migration; forward implementation stops all new writes and reads

methods.inspectRevisionForUsage: REVISION_BINDING_PUBLISH or REVISION_FROZEN_USE; read exact revision, schema descriptors and compatibility and freeze the action
methods.lockAndRevalidateRevisionForUsage: MANDATORY; lock exact revision fact after all consumer-policy calls and revalidate the same revision action
methods.createBusinessInstance: MANDATORY CREATE; insert the caller-preallocated instanceId for a trusted owner tuple
methods.inspectInstance: READ, PATCH, COMPLETE, CLONE_SOURCE, FILE_READ or FILE_WRITE; read frozen schema, values and all controlled file facts and freeze the exact action
methods.patchInstanceValues: MANDATORY PATCH; partial ordinary-value CAS; controlled file keys rejected
methods.cloneBusinessInstance: MANDATORY CLONE_SOURCE plus CLONE_TARGET; use the caller-preallocated target instanceId, copy frozen revision/values and create independent references
methods.lockAndRevalidateInstance: MANDATORY; lock and compare the complete instance fact using the same action frozen by inspectInstance

transactionRules: lockAndRevalidateRevisionForUsage, createBusinessInstance, patchInstanceValues, cloneBusinessInstance and lockAndRevalidateInstance use propagation MANDATORY and reject a call without the SOL outer transaction
PLT does not construct SOL business events

operations.inspectRevisionCompatibility: input REVISION_BINDING_PUBLISH or REVISION_FROZEN_USE and freeze that same action
operations.inspectInstanceOwnerPolicy: input CREATE, READ, PATCH, COMPLETE, CLONE_SOURCE, CLONE_TARGET, FILE_READ or FILE_WRITE with the complete owner key and freeze that same action
operations.lockAndRevalidateInstanceOwnerPolicy: MANDATORY; compare the prior action, actor, owner key, scopeVersion and owner state without action substitution

actionPolicy.REVISION_BINDING_PUBLISH: schema compatible and exact revision is current ENABLED PUBLISHED; PROJ separately authorizes template administration
actionPolicy.REVISION_FROZEN_USE: schema compatible immutable PUBLISHED revision; later disablement or current pointer change is ignored
actionPolicy.CREATE: current project manager may create the first current DRAFT for the frozen WorkBinding
actionPolicy.READ: PROJECT_VIEW may read current, effective or authorized history
actionPolicy.PATCH: current project manager may edit only the current DRAFT
actionPolicy.COMPLETE: current project manager may complete only the current DRAFT when blockers are empty
actionPolicy.CLONE_SOURCE: current project manager may read and clone only the current effective COMPLETED source
actionPolicy.CLONE_TARGET: current project manager may create only the unique next current DRAFT target
actionPolicy.FILE_READ: PROJECT_VIEW may read, download or preview files for a visible DRAFT or COMPLETED version
actionPolicy.FILE_WRITE: current project manager may upload, reference, replace or detach only on the current DRAFT

operationRules.inspectRevisionCompatibility: validate only the PRE-04 schema/usage contract; PROJ separately authorizes the project-template administrator
operationRules.inspectInstanceOwnerPolicy: validate project scope, functional permission, current manager and SOL owner state without writes
operationRules.lockAndRevalidateInstanceOwnerPolicy: lock the SOL owner/root facts and compare the complete frozen owner-policy fact before any PLT lock

responsibilities: validate 11 core rich-text fields, exactly one matching controlled attachment field for each core, and three mandatory value rules
validate PROJECT_VIEW/PROJECT_MANAGE and current project manager facts for instance actions
allow writes only for the current DRAFT
allow read/download/preview for authorized completed history
return stable scopeVersion without exposing raw provider failures
businessObjectPolicyProvider.lockBoundary: all SOL provider calls finish before the first PLT lock; no callback after that point

fileComposition.unknownResponse: reuse the same slotKey and file-command Idempotency-Key, then refresh PLT facts
fileComposition.clonePolicy: new instance references reuse immutable source FileVersions but use new owner slots
fileComposition.events: PLATFORM reuses F-PLT-001 FileEventFactory.referenceAttached and PlatformTransactionalOutboxWriter; exactly one FileReferenceAttached for each actually inserted target reference, replay adds zero and batch failure rolls back all events

order: preallocate preparationId and dynamicFormInstanceId without a business write
insert SOL root version=1 with the non-null preallocated dynamicFormInstanceId
lock CREATE owner policy for the exact SOL root
MANDATORY create PLT business instance using the exact preallocated instanceId
createInitial.idPolicy: caller preallocation; PLATFORM must not generate a different instance ID and SOL performs no post-insert ID backfill or version increment
createInitial.commitInvariant: a persisted PRE-04 root is never committed with null dynamic_form_instance_id; any failure rolls back both inserts and all success facts

order: insert target SOL root with the non-null preallocated targetDynamicFormInstanceId
validate all source and target owner policies
lock source and target PLT instances/revisions
lock all Artifact->Version->Reference facts in stable global order
MANDATORY clone values into the exact preallocated target instance ID and insert target references
createNextDraft.idPolicy: caller preallocation with no SOL ID backfill or extra version increment

order: SOL root, draft/effective rows and all SOL owner-policy facts
PLT dynamic-form instance and frozen revision
complete.rule: no SOL callback after the first PLT lock

versionHeaders.patchForm: If-Match=expected PLT dynamic-form instanceVersion; X-SOL-If-Match=expected SOL root content/version
versionHeaders.complete: If-Match=expected PLT dynamic-form instanceVersion; X-SOL-If-Match=expected SOL root content/version
versionHeaders.createNextDraft: If-Match=expected source PLT instanceVersion; X-SOL-If-Match=expected source SOL root version

completion.richTextVisibleValue: strip markup, decode entities and remove invisible whitespace before checking emptiness
completion.platformValidation: require declarativeValidationResult=VALID for required, JSON type, length/range, regex and enum constraints; client events/functions/parseFunc/remote API/iframe are not server completion facts
completion.allowedAction: COMPLETE only when blockers are empty and every expected fact is known
completion.versionConflict: missing or stale If-Match PLT instanceVersion or X-SOL-If-Match SOL root version returns VERSION_CONFLICT before completion writes

requirementAnalysisFactApi.history: a historical COMPLETED version remains inspectable and reports isCurrentEffective=false

permissions.files: SOL permission + dynamic-form owner policy + F-PLT-001 action permission
permissions.allowedActions: server projection from current PROJ, SOL, PLT and blocker facts

idempotencyAudit.inProgress: stable PMS-PLATFORM-COMMAND-IN-PROGRESS with no success response or side effect
idempotencyAudit.patch: PLT instance If-Match plus SOL root version

seeds: PRE-04 compatible standard dynamic-form template and published revision
project WorkBinding that freezes the exact PLT revision

acceptance.wholeLoop: project-template admin selects compatible PLT revision -> project freezes WorkBinding -> manager creates PRE-04 without selection -> fills values/files -> completes V1 -> clones V2 -> changes/completes -> history/compare -> fact revalidation
realMySql: caller-preallocated instance ID is non-null on the first SOL insert, identical in PLATFORM, causes no backfill version increment and rolls both sides back on failure
all PLATFORM write and lock-holding methods reject execution without an existing caller transaction
inspect and lock revalidation use the identical closed business action and reject action substitution
completion and clone require both expected SOL root and PLT instance versions; either stale version causes zero writes
N cloned references produce N events, replay zero, batch failure zero
realBrowser: automatic template resolution with no project-user selection
template compatibility rejects any missing or duplicate core attachment field while allowing every attachment value to remain empty
full FormCreate values and controlled files
acceptance.scopeGuard: no SCH-01, Deployment, SIT, UAT or Release claim
